correctness.rationale: A block flip changes energy only on two boundary bonds. A wall must be a radius-k strict minimum of iid bond strengths, and all such minima are separated; even wall subsets give exactly 2^(M_k) stable configurations, accounting for ring spin parity and global spin reversal. For k=1,2, local overlap integrals under the probability-integral transform give p11(2)=2/15,p12(2)=1/18,p12(3)=8/105,p22(3)=1/20,p22(4)=2/45. Independently recomputed exact SymPy integrals produce those values, and cyclic displacement sums for n>=11 yield Var(M1)/n=2/45, Cov(M1,M2)/n=-1/315, Var(M2)/n=13/450. The bounded 4-dependent vector indicator process and Cramer–Wold give the joint Gaussian limit, with cyclic cut changes O(1) only. The finite-n restriction avoids cyclic window collision. These analytical steps, not saved verifier logs, support all n>=11.
